summary: For each cell, inspect the cell in the same column at row height-1-row. A cyan(8) cell becomes red(2) exactly when that mirrored cell is also cyan; any other cyan cell becomes gray(5); every non-cyan cell becomes black(0). On odd-height grids, a cyan center-row cell mirrors itself and therefore becomes red.
